runbooks.title: Local migration failure
runbooks.trigger: A local migration or SQL contract exits non-zero.
diagnose: Capture the failing migration name and semantic error code.
Confirm the command targeted only the ephemeral local project id.
contain: Stop later migrations and dependent tests.
Do not link, push, or contact a remote Supabase project.
recover: Tear down the ephemeral local stack without retaining fixtures.
Fix only the owning migration or contract before starting a fresh local stack.
verify: Apply every migration from an empty local database.
Run SQL contracts, fixture rollback, teardown, and residual scan.

runbooks.title: Evidence or gate failure
runbooks.trigger: A targeted gate, preflight, or evidence validator exits non-zero.
diagnose: Record the exact command, exit status, HEAD, and first semantic failure marker.
Check index locks and worktree cleanliness without deleting or bypassing either.
contain: Do not run the full regression again.
Do not promote any row whose required evidence is incomplete.
recover: Correct only the owning source or generated artifact.
Regenerate documentation from its canonical machine-readable source.
verify: Run preflight in the mode required by the checkpoint.

runbooks.title: Local distribution contract failure
runbooks.trigger: The local artifact, service worker, readonly, or missing-backend contract fails.
diagnose: Identify the first missing tracked asset or unsafe cache route.
Confirm public config contains no privileged credential.
contain: Do not publish, push, deploy, or claim hosted evidence.
Keep the last validated local artifact available for comparison.
recover: Regenerate the local distribution inventory from tracked files.
Repair only the failing cache, config, or entrypoint contract.
verify: Run distribution targeted tests against exact HEAD.
Confirm teardown and zero listener/process residue.
